displayText.simplePara: All AMPEL360-AIR-T aircraft S1000D data modules

levelledPara.title: BREX Overview
Scope
levelledPara.para: This BREX applies to all S1000D data modules created for ATA Chapter 31 (Indicating and Recording Systems) and related subsystems.

levelledPara.title: BR-001: Model Identifier
levelledPara.para: All data modules shall use modelIdentCode "AMPEL360AT".

levelledPara.title: BR-002: System Diff Code
levelledPara.para: Standard configuration shall use systemDiffCode "A". Variant configurations may use "B", "C", etc. as defined in configuration management plan.

levelledPara.title: BR-003: Language and Country
levelledPara.para: Primary language shall be English (US): languageIsoCode="en", countryIsoCode="US". Additional language variants shall be created as separate data modules.

levelledPara.title: BR-004: Security Classification
levelledPara.para: Default security classification shall be "01" (Unclassified). Sensitive data modules may use higher classifications as approved by security officer.

levelledPara.title: BR-005: Responsible Partner Company
levelledPara.para: All data modules shall list "AMPEL360-AIR-T Project" as responsiblePartnerCompany and originator.

levelledPara.title: BR-006: BREX Reference
levelledPara.para: All data modules (except this BREX itself) shall reference this BREX data module in the brexDmRef element.

levelledPara.title: BR-007: Quality Assurance Status
levelledPara.para: Data modules in development shall be marked as <unverified/>. Released data modules shall be marked as <firstVerification/> or <secondVerification/> as appropriate.

levelledPara.title: BR-008: ATA Chapter Coding
levelledPara.para: System codes shall follow ATA iSpec 2200 numbering: - ATA 31 = systemCode "31" - Subsystems follow subSystemCode and subSubSystemCode per ATA breakdown

levelledPara.title: BR-009: Information Codes
levelledPara.para: Standard information codes shall be used: - 040A: Description and Operation - 520A: Servicing - 720A: Removal/Installation - 730A: Testing and Fault Isolation - 940A: Illustrated Parts Data

levelledPara.title: BR-010: Issue Information
levelledPara.para: Issue numbers shall follow format: issueNumber (3 digits) - inWork (2 digits). Initial issue shall be "001-00". In-work updates increment inWork number. Official releases increment issueNumber and reset inWork to "00".

levelledPara.title: Validation
levelledPara.para: All data modules shall be validated against this BREX using an S1000D-compliant validation tool prior to release. Non-compliance shall be documented and approved by the data module manager.

levelledPara.title: Maintenance
levelledPara.para: This BREX shall be reviewed and updated as project requirements evolve. Changes to BREX rules require approval from the technical publications manager and configuration control board.
